title: A connector a person holds
description: What POST /api/v1/connectors/{name}/hold answers: when the connector was held and by whom, and how many queued tasks it holds now. A held connector runs no poll or scan, and no worker claims its queued poll or any queued task of an item it sighted until POST /api/v1/connectors/{name}/release. Holding it again keeps the first hold's time and decider.

hold_decided_by.description: person:<login>, or service:<client id> where a service held it.

held.description: The queued tasks held by the connector, through this hold or its first fill.
